ThingDef.label: wraith bio-fluid propellant
ThingDef.description: A dense cultivated biochemical propellant expressed by living Wraith industry. Colonists can haul and stockpile it like any other resource; Wraith gravship fuel bladders accept only this fuel.

ThingDef.label: Asuran nanite slurry
ThingDef.description: A stabilized suspension of finite Replicator-derived nanites in a gravitic carrier. Colonists can haul and stockpile it normally; Asuran gravship fuel cells accept only this slurry.
